katerina.name: Katerina
katerina.quote: The management are great and very forward-thinking. They go the extra mile for their team, making it a great place to work with great colleagues, which also shows in the quality of the work produced.

grigory.name: Grigory
grigory.quote: Seriously, what is this place? This is my idea of heaven :)

michalis.name: Michalis
michalis.quote: Scorewarrior is like my extended family. We have really good times here, and I look forward to coming in to work every day.

anastasia.name: Anastasia
anastasia.quote: I couldn't ask for a better environment to work in! I am blessed to be part of this team.

christina.name: Christina
christina.quote: I could never have imagined that working with games would be a part of my job. Every day is like 'let's have fun at work'.

stelios.name: Stelios
stelios.quote: I'm grateful to be part of a company that prioritises employees' self improvement and makes us feel valued and appreciated.
